slots.notes: Four full-bleed feature-tab stage images, cross-faded one at a time inside the 16:10 image stage; reused as tutorial thumbnails in the ExclusiveTutorial panel. Order matters (one per tab).
Six module/template cover thumbnails cycled through the Courses (16:9 thumbs) and Templates (browser-frame thumbs) dashboard-mock card grids.
Six muted autoplay looping background-video tiles in the BackgroundsTabContent 3x2 grid (autoplay muted loop playsinline); fall back to a matching poster image per tile if a source 404s.
Transparent play-button glyph overlaid bottom-right on background-video tiles and floating on the featured tutorial card.
Circular user-avatar in the dashboard-mock header right group, rendered as a bg-cover/bg-center ring-1 circle.
Primary sans typeface (Inter, weights 300-700) used for every heading, pill, paragraph, nav label and caption; layout tracking is tuned to its metrics.

Variable icon webfont (Material Symbols Rounded) driving all glyphs via the MIcon component (rocket_launch, search, grid_view, school, dashboard, play_circle, auto_awesome, sell, add, notifications, arrow_back, arrow_forward).

mechanic: An auto-rotating 4-tab feature carousel (5s interval, stops on first interaction) whose images cross-fade inside a 16:10 stage, wrapped in three mouse-tracked radial-gradient spotlight borders, with a ResizeObserver-autoscaled 900x562 glassmorphic dashboard mock fading in over each tab.
techDelivery: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + TailwindCSS + framer-motion multi-file component spec (clsx + tailwind-merge cn helper), no single-file CDN bundle.
reskinNotes: Hex/rgb colors are baked inline in JSX (#000000 body, #0e0e0e and #0e0e0e stage fill, rgb(59,130,246) blue accents, the 135deg rocket brand gradient) rather than tokens; base theme uses HSL Tailwind CSS-variable tokens (--background 270 80% 3%, --foreground 0 0% 100%) plus a landing.surface rgba token. All copy (headline, eyebrow, paragraph, nav/tab labels, captions, 'UI Rocket' brand, 'Invite' CTA) is hardcoded in markup. The dashboard mock is a fixed 900x562 canvas with a hardcoded w-[210px] sidebar, so layout is font-metric- and pixel-dependent. Asset URLs are hardcoded as img/video src with no local imports (placeholder higgs.ai images, CloudFront MP4s, Supabase SVG/PNGs, pravatar avatar).
